verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a Developer REST API with a Transactions API. It uses OAuth 2.0 with client-credentials, authorization-code and refresh grants and granular resource:permission scopes such as transactions:read, with least-privilege guidance. A live probe confirms a parseable OpenAPI spec with 174 paths, including /developer/v1/transactions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of REST endpoints for pulling receipts and reimbursements/expenses (reimbursements:read and receipts:write appear only in MCP scope metadata and CLI resources), and independent hands-on corroboration of authenticated data pulls.
